1274 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
300 days before 06-22-1274:  
Back up 22 days → 06-01-1274.  
Back up 31 days (May) → 05-01-1274.  
Back up 30 days (April) → 04-01-1274.  
Back up 31 days (March) → 03-01-1274.  
Back up 28 days (Feb) → 02-01-1274.  
Back up 31 days (Jan) → 01-01-1274.  
That’s 22+31+30+31+28+31 = 173 days.  
Remaining 300 − 173 = 127 days to go back into 1273.  
1273 is a common year (1273 mod 4 = 1).  
Back up 31 days (Dec 1273) → 12-01-1273 (31 days).  
Back up 30 days (Nov) → 11-01-1273 (61 days).  
Back up 31 days (Oct) → 10-01-1273 (92 days).  
Back up 30 days (Sep) → 09-01-1273 (122 days).  
Need 127 total, so 5 more days back from 09-01-1273:  
→ 08-27-1273.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1273-08-27
